IncidentDef.label: a dream of a place for a god

texts.li: [!priest] {GIVER} woke this morning and told the others at breakfast about a dream. In it, {GIVER} says, {NAME} showed them a place on the colony's land, {WAY} of the colony, and asked for a {KIND} to be built there.

[priest] {GIVER}, who leads the colony's prayers, told the others at breakfast about a dream. In it, {GIVER} says, {NAME} showed them a place on the colony's land, {WAY} of the colony, and asked for a {KIND} to be built there.

li.label: Build it
li.outcome: The colony will build a {KIND} where {GIVER} dreamed it.

lines.li: [built] This is the place I saw in my dream.

terms.li: The place {GIVER} saw is marked on the map. If the colony agrees, it has {DAYS} to build an altar, a shrine or a work of art inside the marked area. Once one stands there, someone of the colony will go and give it to {NAME}.\n\nIf it is built and given to {NAME} in time, {GIVER} will be glad. If not, {GIVER} will be troubled for a while.

accepted.li: The place {GIVER} dreamed of is marked on the map, {WAY} of the colony. Build an altar, a shrine or a work of art inside it.

reminder.li: Nothing for {NAME} has been built yet at the place {GIVER} dreamed of.

notes.li: [standing] A place for {NAME} stands where {GIVER} dreamed it. Someone of the colony will go and give it to {NAME}.

ends.li: [built] The colony built {ITEM} where {GIVER} dreamed it, and gave it to {NAME}. {GIVER} is glad.
[notbuilt] Nothing was built for {NAME} at the place {GIVER} dreamed of, and {GIVER} is troubled by it.

IncidentDef.label: a watch at the new place

texts.li: A few days ago the colony built a {KIND} for {NAME} where {GIVER} dreamed it. Now {GIVER} wants someone to keep a watch there one night, and says something will happen there.

li.label: Keep the watch
li.outcome: {GIVER} will go out to the {KIND} at night.

li.label: Decline
li.outcome: Nobody will keep a watch at the {KIND}.

lines.li: [seen] Did you see that light over the {KIND}?
[unwatched] I waited, but nobody kept the watch with me.

terms.li: If the colony agrees, someone of the colony needs to be at the {KIND} for two hours of the night, between nine in the evening and four in the morning, within the next three nights. {GIVER} goes out to it each night, and anyone of the colony there counts.\n\nIf nobody keeps the watch, nothing more is asked of the colony now.

accepted.li: {GIVER} will go out to the {KIND} at night to keep the watch.

ends.li: [seen] {ITEM} was keeping the watch at the {KIND} in the night when a light came over it for a short while. {GIVER} says this is what the dream meant.
[unwatched] Nobody of the colony kept the watch at the {KIND} for long enough, and nothing was seen there.

IncidentDef.label: an offering asked in a dream

texts.li: [seen] A few days ago a light was seen over the new {KIND} during the watch. Last night {GIVER} had the same dream again, and says {NAME} asked for an offering to be left at the {KIND}.

[nowatch] A few days ago {GIVER} asked for a watch at the new {KIND}, and nothing was seen there. Last night {GIVER} had the same dream again, and says {NAME} asked for an offering to be left at the {KIND}.

li.label: Give the offering
li.outcome: The colony will leave an offering at the {KIND}.

li.label: Refuse
li.outcome: {GIVER} will be troubled for a while.

lines.li: [given] I am glad we did what my dream asked.

terms.li: {GIVER} says {NAME} asked for {ITEM}. If the colony agrees, it has {DAYS} to leave it at the {KIND}. {GIVER} will carry it there if the colony's stores have it.\n\nIf it is given, {GIVER} will be glad and will remember it. If it is refused or not brought in time, {GIVER} will be troubled for a while.

accepted.li: {GIVER} will carry {ITEM} to the {KIND} if the colony's stores have it.

ends.li: [given] The colony left {ITEM} at the {KIND}, as {GIVER}'s dream asked. {GIVER} is glad, and believes {NAME} wanted it.
[notgiven] Nobody left {ITEM} at the {KIND} in time, and {GIVER} is troubled by it.
